test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the following series were to continue?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3519e824d4645b6cfdba95d0007c6e175f2996c5f738b55c3a9c0ac3f0fafeb4.png]
solution:
The pattern followed in the given series is:

**'B' and 'O' move from left to right after every step.**

**The character in top and bottom shifts towards right.**

**The character in middle column shift downwards. **

Next step:

**'B' and 'O' will be at left side.**

**The character in top and bottom layer will shift towards right.**

**'T' will remain at the same position.**

Now we consider the given options:

Option 1) Position of every character is incorrect.

Option 2) The pattern is correct.

Option 3) Position of only 'B' is correct.

Option 4) Position of only 'B' and 'O' is correct.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a50bb90990c0a38066048581fa71ef0fbadcade29463f1a939a379c1b374861.png] 

Hence **the correct answer is option 2)**
